blockers: Per-user authenticated password flow is functionally incorrect.
Audit failure handling and privileged mutation audit coverage do not meet the stated requirements.
Account/audit UI is absent, as expected for follow-up.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing Rollup annotation warnings.
Creates users/audit_events and migrates legacy admin_password to owner admin account with bootstrap audit event.

Cookie name is v2; uid/security_stamp claims are checked against current account; owner policy protects account and audit endpoints; unsafe authenticated routes receive CSRF filter; generic API mutators restrict viewer role.
POST /api/auth/password calls SetupCodeService.ChangePasswordAsync (global admin_password) before changing current account, violating any-authenticated-user own-password behavior.
AuditService catches all exceptions with an empty catch, so audit failures are not logged/surfaced.
Existing operational mutations and generic viewer-denied mutations do not emit audit events.
No account-management or audit-event screens/routes are present; expected follow-up gap.

next_slice.summary: Developer follow-up should fix per-user password validation/update, log audit-write failures, and add audit coverage for privileged success/failure/denied mutations; UI account/audit screens remain a planned follow-up.

result: Backend tests and frontend build pass, but RBAC/audit review found material defects. Legacy owner migration, owner-only account/audit routing, role claims with security-stamp invalidation, CSRF filtering, and secret-free audit schema are present. The authenticated password endpoint is incorrect for non-owner users and becomes inconsistent after owner account-password changes: it validates against legacy global admin_password rather than the requesting account. Audit failures are silently swallowed, and existing privileged mutations/denied viewer mutations are generally not audited. Account/audit UI screens are absent as an explicitly expected follow-up.
